explanations.P: Back up the throw to second base.
explanations.1B: Be prepared for either an overthrow to second or a throw back to first.
explanations.SS: Be the cutoff man between the left fielder and second base.
explanations.3B: Don’t stray too far from third base. Be prepared for either a deflection or the need to cover third.

explanations.P: Back up the throw to second base.
explanations.1B: Be prepared for a throw to first base from either second base or right field.
explanations.2B: Be the cutoff man between the right fielder and second base.
explanations.3B: Don’t stray too far from third base. Be prepared for either an overthrow of second base or the need to cover third.

explanations.P: Move into foul territory and back up the throw to third base.
explanations.1B: Be prepared for a throw back to first.
explanations.2B: Cover second base in the event the runner retreats.
explanations.SS: Be the cutoff man between the left fielder and third base.

explanations.1B: Be prepared for a throw back to first.
explanations.2B: Cover second base in the event the runner retreats.

explanations.2B: Cover second base in the event the runner retreats.

explanations.P: Move into foul territory behind the catcher to back up the throw home.
explanations.1B: Be prepared for a throw back to first.
explanations.2B: Cover second base in the event the batter advances to second following a throw home.
explanations.3B: Be the cutoff man between the left fielder and home plate.

explanations.P: Move into foul territory behind the catcher to back up the throw home.
explanations.1B: Be the cutoff man immediately behind the mound between the center fielder and home plate.
explanations.2B: Cover first base. Be prepared for a possible throw from the cutoff man or the catcher.
explanations.SS: Cover second base in the event the batter advances to second following a throw home.
explanations.3B: Cover third base. Be prepared for a throw to third if the runner retreats.

explanations.P: Move into foul territory behind the catcher to back up the throw home.
explanations.1B: Be the cutoff man between the right fielder and home plate.
explanations.2B: Cover first base. Be prepared for a possible throw from the cutoff man or the catcher.
explanations.SS: Cover second base in the event the batter advances to second following a throw home.
explanations.3B: Cover third base. Be prepared for a throw to third if the runner retreats.

explanations.P: Move into foul territory to back up a throw to third base.
explanations.1B: Once it’s a clear extra base hit and middle infielders break for the outfield, cover second base.
explanations.2B: If the ball gets by the outfielders, head for the outfield to be a second cutoff man to play anything that gets through the shortstop. Also communicate with the shortstop about the throw.
explanations.SS: If the ball gets by the outfielders, head for the outfield to be the first cutoff man to make a relay throw to third base.

explanations.P: Move into foul territory, slightly to the first base side, to back up a throw home.
explanations.1B: Once it’s a clear extra base hit and middle infielders break for the outfield, cover second base.

explanations.SS: If the ball gets by the outfielders, head for the outfield to be the first cutoff man to make a relay throw to home or third base, depending on where there’s a play.

explanations.P: Move into foul territory to back up a throw home, slightly to 3B side to back up 3B if necessary.
